Title: The Historical Context and Discredited Claims of the "Protocols of the Elders of Zion"

The "Protocols of the Elders of Zion" is a document that has long been a subject of controversy and historical scrutiny. Originally published in 1903, the Protocols purport to outline a secret plan by a cabal of Jewish leaders to achieve global dominance through control of finance, media, and governance. The Origins and Discrediting of the Protocols

The Protocols were first disseminated by the Russian Empire, with evidence showing they were plagiarized from Dialogue in Hell Between Machiavelli and Montesquieu (1864), a French satire mocking revolutionary ideals. Scholars and experts have concluded that the document was fabricated to inflame antisemitism, a claim corroborated by the 1921 British Royal Commission on the Protocols, which ruled the text a hoax. Despite this, the Protocols gained traction among extremist groups, including Nazi propagandists, who used them to justify persecution. This historical background underscores the Protocols' role as a weapon of conspiracy rather than an authentic blueprint for global control.

Conclusion

The "Protocols of the Elders of Zion" is a discredited hoax that has been used to justify hatred and violence.
